C1223.title: Commentary | 159 Yuan Plan Less Cost-Effective Than 39 Yuan Plan: Operators Must Lose More Than They Gain from Big Data Discrimination
C1223.summary: A long-term user paying 159 yuan for a mobile plan receives less value than a new user's 39 yuan plan, allegedly violating the rights to fair trade and free choice. The implementation rules of the Consumer Protection Law explicitly prohibit setting different prices or fee standards for different consumers under equivalent transaction conditions.

references.title: Commentary: 159 Yuan Plan Less Cost-Effective Than 39 Yuan; Discriminatory Operators Must Face Consequences
